title: How a 14-year-old built totally science, a 300K-visitor unblocked games site, and what he learned
summary: Zach Yadegari explains how he built an unblocked games hub in 8th grade, grew it through TikTok and school-to-school word of mouth, and monetized it with AdSense. He covers scaling pains, small-team structure, and his views on college and next projects.

principles.text: Build the thing you see people already doing badly: consolidate scattered behavior into one hub.
principles.quote: I saw a lot of people had different tabs open with different games on each Tab and different websites with each game and so I decided it would be much better if there was one website that was a hub for all of these games

principles.text: Ship a simple v1 fast; improve it only once real traffic shows it matters.
principles.quote: the original site took me probably just a few days it was very simple it was just a basic layout with games on it nothing fancy at all

principles.text: Ride trending demand: add what's trending, then post a TikTok about it to spark a viral spike.
principles.quote: Retro Bowl is a game that it's like a little football pixel game on phones but there's also versions on computers and on Tik Tok it was trending people trying to play it at school

principles.text: Seed one user per school from organic TikTok, then let peer-to-peer spread do the rest; put the brand name on screen so others see it.
principles.quote: getting an original just one like person in every school just from the organic Tik Tok videos and then from there it spreads organically to everyone else in the district

principles.text: Mine comments for demand and reply with videos announcing the requested feature or game.
principles.quote: another way we try to Market is by looking at the comments finding a game and then replying to that comment with a video saying we just added this game

principles.text: Keep the team tiny with revenue share instead of hiring when the product doesn't need more hands.
principles.quote: we have a a revenue share between us okay that's how our relationship is that's awesome
